factorized_runtime_inputs.release_semantics: release_or_instability evidence, conservative veto candidate, not pure-release equivalent

runtime_offline_separation.offline_calibration_inputs: head_targets, head_known_masks — for calibrator fitting and head discrimination only
runtime_offline_separation.offline_evaluation_inputs: strict_k10_feasible, strict_k10_known_mask, Teacher event metadata — audit-only
runtime_offline_separation.forbidden_crossover: offline labels must not affect scheduler state transitions

episode_classification.eligible_domain: steps 0 to T-10 (positions that can host a complete T10 window)
episode_classification.positive: at least one VALID_START in the eligible domain
episode_classification.negative: ALL positions in eligible domain are known AND strict_k10_feasible=false for ALL
episode_classification.unknown: eligible domain has any unknown position AND no known positive exists
episode_classification.blocked: Teacher bundle lacks complete eligible-domain known info → BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_K10_KNOWN_COVERAGE
episode_classification.no_50pct_threshold: The arbitrary 50% known coverage threshold is REMOVED. Classification uses eligible domain completeness.

k10_corridor.definition: A step t where strict_k10_feasible[t] AND strict_k10_known_mask[t] both true IS a valid emission start.
k10_corridor.no_double_horizon: Do NOT require consecutive feasible-start blocks of length >= 8. That doubles the effective T10 to T17-T19.
k10_corridor.containment: T10 containment is inherent in strict_k10_feasible definition. No further emit_step+9 check needed.
k10_corridor.optional_contiguous_region: For visualization/timing offset only. Min length = 1.
k10_corridor.source: strict_k10_feasible from Teacher label bundle — evaluation only, NOT runtime

L1A_non_close_intent_diagnostic.note: NOT physical background. Includes normal release, OPEN actions, non-grasp phases.

L1B_teacher_background_diagnostic.note: Offline diagnostic only. Cannot enter runtime scheduler.

L3.name: factorized_scheduler_decision
L3.population: all episodes with valid scheduler coverage

positive_on_corridor_emits.definition: emit_step is a VALID_START on a positive episode

positive_off_corridor_emits.definition: scheduler emitted but emit_step is NOT a VALID_START on positive episode

positive_abstentions.definition: scheduler did not emit on positive episode

median_timing_offset.definition: median of (emit_step - containing_VALID_START_region.start). Regions are contiguous blocks of valid starts.

unknown_episode_emits.definition: scheduler emitted on unknown episode — NOT in negative denominator

provenance.INDEPENDENT: calibration identities NOT in checkpoint training → authoritative
provenance.TRAIN_RESUBSTITUTION: calibration identities WERE in checkpoint training → NON_AUTHORITATIVE diagnostic only
